description: Branch R-FMT-2 Historical row coordinates (public side) on a ACCDB. Tables M7, M8, M9, M15, M16, M17 (key plus Long columns, so the column count is the number in the name, around the 8-bit mask boundaries): a row with every column set, and one row per column with only that column Null; all rows read back. Then on M8: add Yes/No, add Long, add Text(10), drop the middle column C3, set the Yes/No True, add a second Yes/No; and on M16: add a Long (17 columns), add a Yes/No; reading all rows after every step. Asks whether Null patterns, appended columns and a dropped column keep every old value in its place, and what an appended Yes/No reads for old rows.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
